Container.Name: hikvision-unifi-fire-bridge
Container.Overview:
Bridges Hikvision (thermal) camera fire-detection events into a UniFi Protect Alarm Manager incoming webhook: camera fire alarm -> Protect siren / priority push notification / any Alarm Manager action. Fail-loud design: re-alerts while the fire stays active, proactive Protect path probe, strict TLS.
NOT certified life-safety equipment. This tool is not a substitute for compliant smoke alarms, fire panels, or emergency procedures, and carries no safety certification of any kind. Use at your own risk in addition to, never instead of, properly certified fire detection.
Container.Requires: A Hikvision camera exposing the ISAPI alert stream, and UniFi Protect with an Alarm Manager incoming webhook + API key. The Protect host must present a valid TLS certificate.

Config.Name: Hikvision scheme
Config.Description: http or https toward the camera.

Config.Name: Protect base URL
Config.Description: HTTPS URL of the UNVR running Protect (certificate-valid hostname, e.g. https://unvr.example.com).

Config.Name: Protect API key
Config.Description: Minimum-scope Protect integration API key (sent as X-API-Key).

Config.Name: Protect webhook URL override
Config.Description: Optional full webhook URL; replaces base URL + webhook ID if your Protect version uses a different path.

Config.Name: Fire event types
Config.Description: Comma-separated eventType values treated as fire (case-insensitive). Empty = fireDetection,fire_detection,fireAlarm.

Config.Name: Fire cooldown seconds
Config.Description: Minimum gap between edge-trigger alerts per source.

Config.Name: Re-alert seconds
Config.Description: Re-alert interval while a fire stays active; 0 disables re-alerting.

Config.Name: Active TTL seconds
Config.Description: Active state expires after this many seconds of silence (anti-latch safety).

Config.Name: Stream idle timeout
Config.Description: Reconnect when the camera stream is silent this long.
